title: Freight
summary: Cargo transit across Australia, New Zealand, the South and Central Pacific and Asia.
seo_description: Freight services on Boeing 737 freighters and passenger aircraft, cargo agents across the Pacific, and freight quotes.

sections.heading: Freight
sections.body: Naoero Airlines offers cargo transit to our clients to various locations in Australia, New Zealand and the South/Central Pacific and Asia. We have a choice of aircraft available including Boeing 737-300, Boeing 737-700 and Boeing 737-800 aircraft available.

sections.heading: Naoero Airlines Freight Fleet
sections.body: Please refer to our news article on the Naoero Post Frigate Service for detailed information about the Brisbane-Naoero Air Mail service. [Click here to learn more.](/news-hub)

items.title: Aviation Standards
items.text: With an Australian Air Operator's Certificate, we uphold the highest aviation standards, operating a fleet of Boeing 737 aircraft.

items.title: Freight Services
items.text: Our freight services accommodate a wide range of cargo needs, from mail to perishable goods, with the capacity and flexibility to handle even the most complex logistical requirements.

items.title: Fleet
items.text: In addition to our dedicated freight fleet, comprising two Boeing 737-300Fs and Australia's first E-TOPS Boeing 737-800F, we also utilise our fleet of four Boeing 737 passenger aircraft to transport cargo across the Pacific.

items.title: Scheduled Network
items.text: Our scheduled routes include Naoero, Fiji, Kiribati, the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the Federated States of Micronesia.
